name: Mortal Kombat: Deception — Liu Kang Biography
notes: Official in-game Liu Kang biography reproduced by Mortal Kombat Warehouse, used here as preservation/access infrastructure rather than canonical authority. Liu Kang retrospectively states that Shang Tsung killed him and consumed his soul. This later Original-continuity primary source independently corroborates the Liu Kang death and soul-consumption outcomes presented in Mortal Kombat: Deadly Alliance.
